cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(JudasIndependentWindowsConsumer LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>DLL")
find_package(SDL2 2.30.12 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(glm 1.0.1 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED)
if(NOT TARGET SDL2::SDL2-static OR NOT TARGET SDL2::SDL2main OR NOT TARGET glm::glm)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Installed dependency CMake targets are incomplete")
endif()
add_executable(consumer ../consumer.cpp)
target_link_libraries(consumer PRIVATE SDL2::SDL2-static glm::glm)
add_executable(consumer_main WIN32 ../consumer.cpp)
target_compile_definitions(consumer_main PRIVATE JUDAS_TEST_SDL_MAIN=1)
target_link_libraries(consumer_main PRIVATE SDL2::SDL2main SDL2::SDL2-static glm::glm)
